label: 1Battery Juice
description: Battery overview of every paired device, before and after the ride.
releaseNotes: Now called 1Battery Juice. The Battery overview page looks like the app: a card for what needs attention, type badges, gauges and time left; devices not seen recently are left off. Levels read 100% / ≤80%. Renamed groupsets prefix their parts ("SRAM Left shifter"), the Karoo can be renamed, and the after-ride notification comes right away.
